Compute the decimal product:

\[
17 \times 243 = 17 \times (200 + 40 + 3)
\]

\[
= 17 \times 200 + 17 \times 40 + 17 \times 3
\]

\[
= 3400 + 680 + 51 = 4131
\]

Verify with a second method:

\[
17 \times 243 = (20 - 3) \times 243
\]

\[
= 20 \times 243 - 3 \times 243
\]

\[
= 4860 - 729 = 4131
\]

So the decimal result is confirmed as 4131.

Convert 4131 to hexadecimal by repeated division by 16:

\[
4131 \div 16 = 258 \text{ remainder } 3
\]

\[
258 \div 16 = 16 \text{ remainder } 2
\]

\[
16 \div 16 = 1 \text{ remainder } 0
\]

\[
1 \div 16 = 0 \text{ remainder } 1
\]

Reading the remainders from last to first gives:

\[
1023_{16}
\]

Check:

\[
0x1023 = 1 \times 16^3 + 0 \times 16^2 + 2 \times 16^1 + 3 \times 16^0
\]

\[
= 4096 + 0 + 32 + 3 = 4131
\]

ANSWER: 4131 (decimal), 0x1023 (hexadecimal)
